change: Superseded 2026-10-26: the DLBA's Policies page no longer links the October 2023 Amended and Restated Vacant Land Policy; the rule now rests on the Second Amended and Restated Vacant Land Policy (adopted 11/11/2025), whose Oversize Lot price is $250 per lot (was $200)
prior_statement: The DLBA's 'Amended and Restated Vacant Land Policy' (final October 2023, 26 pages): Side Lots, Neighborhood Lots and Oversize Lots are DLBA-owned vacant residential lots sold by application at policy prices - 'Side Lots are priced at $100 per lot', a Neighborhood Lot '$250 per lot, unless the estimated value of the lot exceeds $2,500', an Oversize Lot '$200 per lot, unless the estimated value of the lot as determined by the DLBA exceeds $2,500' - to a defined buyer: the owner-occupant of a Detroit home adjacent to (Side / Oversize Lot) or within 500 feet of (Neighborhood Lot) the lot, who holds title, is current on Detroit property taxes and is in good standing with the DLBA; a purchase is made by a 'Complete Application ... to purchase property under this Policy'

prior_statement: Harris County's own tax sale listing (hctax.net, the Tax Assessor-Collector's site) is the only official per-county tax-sale list located for Harris County, and it cannot be used: the site's terms were not cleared for redistribution (registry tx_hctax, Phase 9.5), so the ingestion gate refuses it and no Harris County auction row comes from it.
